name: rust-regression-suite
summary: Lock the review fixes in end-to-end tests
body:
Five new E2E scenarios: splitting a commit mints fresh distinct ids;
a gitlink-only stack reorganizes as whole-file units; a created-then-
truncated file survives the identity plan; plan-hygiene rejections
are E001; and `-- comment` content lines round-trip bit-for-bit.
